{{recipesummary|category=Chicken recipes|servings=4|time=1⅛-2 hours|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Southern cuisine|Southern U.S. cuisine]] 

==Ingredients==

* 1 recipe [[Cookbook:Spice Rub for Chicken|spice rub]] (or use your own recipe)
* 2 [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaves]], crumbled
* 1 can (12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] / ~355 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) of [[Cookbook:Beer|beer]]
* 3–4 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (1.5–2 kg) [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] (dressed)

==Procedure==

# Poke holes all over chicken to let fat run out during cooking.
# Rub chicken thoroughly with spice rub: inside and out, and then under skin as far as you can reach
# Set aside chicken.
# Remove upper racks from oven.
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|350°F]] (180°C).
# When oven preheated, take a healthy drink of the beer, leaving about 9–10 ounces.
# Crumble bay leaves into beer, in beer can.
# Insert beer can '''firmly''' into chicken cavity.
# Place chicken upright in shallow heatproof pan.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] chicken upright for 1–1.5 hours until thickest part is 165°F (73°C).
# When removing chicken from oven, keep upright.
# Rest chicken upright 15 minutes before removing beer can.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* A disposable drip pan will save you a lot of cleanup (and a lot of flares on the outdoor grill).
* This is really best on a charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]], on medium heat.
